The individual survey indexes have been seasonally adjusted using the US Bureau of Census X-11 programme. The seasonally adjusted series are then used to calculate the seasonally adjusted PMI."},{"gmt":"09:30","country":"United States","eventName":"Nonfarm Productivity","actual":" ","consensus":" ","previous":"1.4%","description":"Nonfarm Productivity measures the annualized change in labor efficiency when producing goods and services, excluding the farming industry.
